The bundled files README.rst, requirements.txt, and estimator/ were compared
against the upstream tree at this commit and matched byte-for-byte.  The
LANES.sage file in this directory is RiVeR-specific artifact glue code
and is not part of upstream lattice-estimator.

The upstream README.rst states that lattice-estimator is licensed under
LGPLv3+.  A copy of the LGPLv3 text is included as COPYING.LESSER-3.0.txt.
